# Tender Response — MRE-2026-02
**Visakoivu Oy** to Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen pätevyys covering refrigeration and air conditioning equipment. Visakoivu Oy also holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.1 Fire protection.** Fire protection systems are maintained on a scheduled inspection and service basis, in line with applicable statutory intervals.

**4.2 Corrective maintenance response times.** Standard corrective faults are attended within one working day of the call being logged.

**4.3 Emergency response.** Emergency situations are covered by a dedicated on-call arrangement with response commencing within two hours of the call.

**4.4 Environmental management.** Works are carried out under our environmental management arrangements, covering waste handling and containment of regulated substances on site.

**4.5 Asset register handover.** A full asset register and documentation handover is supported by our 24-person administration team, ensuring records are current and accessible to the client throughout the contract.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Cost breakdown.** A full cost breakdown is provided with the quotation.

**5.2 Payment terms.** 30 days net from invoice date.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1 Personnel.** CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract are attached.

## Annex A

Visakoivu Oy operates an environmental management system covering the works described in this tender.

Visakoivu Oy is a 180-person technical and facility services company based in Jyväskylä, operating across LVI, sähkö, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistönhoito for public and private clients. We look forward to supporting Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy's facilities on this contract.
